name: Aura Cell
comment: Aura Cell offers an indoor air purification system that combines a biotechnology filter for CO₂ capture with real-time air quality monitoring via sensors and artificial intelligence, aimed at customers who need measurable indoor environmental performance. Taxonomy CT-BU-005 Green Roofs & Infrastructure; deck Drive id 1MzA0eKU8UH7RMxQ5ckfxleDfkLySeTzf.

name: MUKAN
comment: MUKAN produces design-grade cellulose-fiber board from Guatemala's corn husk waste, sold to furniture and carpentry workshops as a locally made alternative to imported wood fiber board. Taxonomy CT-IN-003 Circular Economy & Clean Mfg; deck Drive id 167ped9R_QQCZZDuWULVvdYk2o8j7fPmJ.

name: Ecomuna
comment: Ecomuna makes and sells plastic-free toothpaste and mouthwash tablets direct to consumers (B2C), produced in Costa Rica for households seeking natural personal care with reduced plastic packaging. Taxonomy CT-IN-003 Circular Economy & Clean Mfg; deck Drive id 1w_CpVBCba0HWU4sQPOFngRW0SiVTZb41.

name: Fazzty
comment: Fazzty is a climate-tech micromobility offering work-to-own e-bikes for delivery riders in Costa Rica, with fixed weekly pricing tiers as an alternative to motorcycle last-mile delivery. Taxonomy CT-TR-001 Electric Vehicles; deck Drive id 1YVtCFxFt7teNSFyKxzcEai08iHWeC0xp.

name: GMOVES
comment: GMOVES makes compostable coffee-wood stirrers for coffee shop chains, with a take-back and on-farm composting model intended to replace single-use plastic stirrers and support circularity in the coffee supply chain. Taxonomy CT-WA-003 Recycling & Materials Recovery; deck Drive id 1AfWRusScMPNMQyU_a2gcPwBCat90Ml5v.

name: Ingenicrop
comment: Ingenicrop connects farmers with data and decision support to improve yield and reduce inputs, with implementation referenced in Guatemala, El Salvador, and Honduras and digitalization of farm hectares. Taxonomy CT-AF-007 Precision Agri Data; deck Drive id 1eADUFlPFYzNCGnB4vdcgtBgNrlDnoOpZ.

name: NRK
comment: NRK is a fashion brand that upcycles existing garments into new design pieces, recovering thrifted clothing to reduce textile waste and associated water and emissions impacts from conventional production. Taxonomy CT-EX-038 Sustainable Textiles (Wood/Fibre); deck Drive id 128lfgpV0gnlB4Mk5X0571hRfzcmznzlE.

name: Plastic Free Planet
comment: Plastic Free Planet turns beach-collected plastic into durable outdoor furniture such as recycled chairs for Caribbean eco-hotels, operating a closed loop of collection, production, sales, and community education from Puerto Viejo, Costa Rica. Taxonomy CT-WA-003 Recycling & Materials Recovery; deck Drive id 1R2UqC8-SnR9KmlcFwIIhFaK0-J8TkjjK.
